title: Dominating Set by rank-width
task: Does G have a set of at most k vertices such that every vertex either belongs to the set or has a neighbor in the set?
encoding: A finite, simple, undirected, unweighted graph G and a nonnegative integer k.
parameter: The rank-width of G, denoted by p. Cut rank is computed over the binary field.
coverage: Historical ETH and independently reviewed recoveries.

reader.parameter: The rank-width of G, denoted by p. Cut rank is computed over the binary field.

symbols.meaning: complete binary input length, including a supplied certificate if present

inputConditions.condition: The graph is monopolar, meaning that its vertices can be partitioned into an independent set and an induced disjoint union of cliques.

bounds.statement: Under ETH, no deterministic algorithm decides Dominating Set within the stated running time.

reader.title: Subexponential bound in squared width under ETH

bounds.statement: Under FPT ≠ W[1], no deterministic algorithm decides Dominating Set within the stated running time.
